== Introduction ==
A [[ZTNDM3]] only 1on1 tournament organized by [[phil]]. 

* '''Running date:''' 15th of May, 2008 - 16th of July, 2008
* '''Website:''' [http://quakephil.com/ztndm3/?sid=1 http://quakephil.com/ztndm3/?sid=1]
* '''Signups:''' 62 players (20 - Russian, 11 - Swedish, 5- German, and 11 more countries represented)
